newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Seat signs lead ad contract with Wilkens.
newsitem.headline: German Seat signs lead ad contract with Wilkens.

text.p: German automaker Seat Deutschland GmbH on Friday beat back industry rumours about a shift in its advertising representation by signing a long-term contract with Wilkens GmbH as its lead German agency.

Account Executive Toni Mueller of Wilkens Frankfurt called the agreement a clear signal that Wilkens would remain its lead ad agency and dismissed speculation that other agencies who had run large campaigns for Seat had edged in on that position.
"When the agency Boening & Haube ran an international project for Seat, there was talk in the industry that we were no longer the Seat agency," Mueller said. "That is not the case."
Industry sources estimate the Seat account for print and broadcast media advertising at up to 40 million marks ($23.2 million). Wilkens did not provide details on the length of the contract.
The Wilkens group includes two traditional ad agencies in Frankfurt and Hamburg and several specialised agencies. ($ = 1.720 German Marks)
